implementation.shadow_sync: shadow.load_state_dict(model.state_dict()) once at the start of every canonical step k
implementation.mutation_rule: trajectory model is never mutated by counterfactuals
implementation.group_restore: restore each perturbed shadow group from its theta_k snapshot before the next group
implementation.canonical_update: apply direct SGD to trajectory model only after all group counterfactuals at step k

forward_contract.counterfactual_E: no replay forward; evaluate all L1 expert functions on cached base H_k
forward_contract.counterfactual_R_L1: no replay forward; deltaE is structural zero
forward_contract.gate_weighting: pre-update natural G_k for every group, regardless of G'_X

cached_intermediates.group_grad_loss: canonical forced-pair loss gradients for each live group
cached_intermediates.group_grad_q: first-order q gradients for each live group

checks.expected_forward_inclusions: 8 full upstream-group replay forwards; E direct evaluation; R_L1 skipped; structural-zero groups logged as exact zero without forward

performance.reason: Use full replay counterfactuals as the reference implementation; optimization is deliberately deferred.
